[[test]]
name = "test_code_design"
path = "tests/test_code_design.rs"

[[bench]]
name = "detectors"
harness = false

[package]
name = "rust-faces"
version = "2.0.0"
edition = "2024"
authors = [ "Rusty Builder <usty_builder@mail2world.com>",]
description = "A Rust library for face detection"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/rustybuilder/rust-faces"
readme = "README.md"

[dependencies]
image = "0.25.10"
ndarray = "0.17.2"
thiserror = "2.0.20"
itertools = "0.15.0"
indicatif = "0.18.6"
directories = "6.0.0"

[features]
default = []
viz = [ "dep:imageproc",]

[dev-dependencies]
rstest = "0.26.1"

[dependencies.ort]
version = "2.0.0-rc.14"
features = [ "load-dynamic", "cuda", "coreml", "vitis",]

[dependencies.nshare]
version = "0.10.0"
features = [ "ndarray",]

[dependencies.imageproc]
version = "0.27.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13.4"
features = [ "blocking",]

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.8.2"
features = [ "html_reports",]
